proposed.reason: Diagnostic recorder has no visible native entry in the production shell; force-clicking or calling its private start API would manufacture reachability.
proposed.evidence: site/components/ObjectShell.astro:251 renders data-diagnostic-record with hidden; site/diagnostic-recorder.mts:99 queries that button, createDiagnosticRecorder binds click at line 92 and starts RAF/error listeners at lines 68-70. No application code removes its hidden attribute (source search). Tranche e native capabilities-recorder probe asserts the missing visible entry.

proposed.reason: The diagnostic download link is created unattached and clicked programmatically only after the hidden recorder is stopped; no visible native activation path exists.
proposed.evidence: site/diagnostic-recorder.mts:136-141 creates an unattached anchor and calls link.click() in the recorder download callback; stop at lines 74-88 calls download only after start, whose native button is hidden at site/components/ObjectShell.astro:251. Native trusted-control attribution cannot credit a scripted click or an unattached anchor.

proposed.reason: Shared world survives detail navigation; its mount abort is available only during loading at router disposal, before the current ready-load API returns. Outgoing document observations are not retained after replacement.
proposed.evidence: site/application-world-context.mts:38 registers signal abort; site/scene/scene-world.mts:31-59 creates the controller only in loading state, destroy at lines 124-130 aborts only loading state; site/scene/scene-router.mts:166 binds pagehide to destroyActiveScene, whose session disposal runs at line 614. journeyApi.load waits through the ready barrier before returning. Tranche e ready-page navigation did not invoke this abort.
